setup: npm install, and a checkout of ReceiptPrinterPlayground next to this repository, RENDERER_PLAYGROUND overrides the path, see tools/external/playground/capture.js
notes: The pdf417 sample of the playground's "New..." menu, section 16g. The sizes, the error levels and the column counts. Evaluated the way src/utils/encoder.js of the playground does, in an async function with an `encoder` of 48 columns and a `model` of 'Generic', which is what the playground puts there when no printer model is selected. Reviewed as ASCII art against the render of the other language of the same width.
